name: Spotlight
scaffolding_intent: Isolates a character, object, or the setting by darkening the rest of the scene and adding a luminous halo, prompting the child to identify it

parameters.name: dimStrength
parameters.description: How much non-target pixels are dimmed

parameters.name: haloColor
parameters.description: Color of the halo around entity

correction_intent: Child confused two entities or named a wrong one ('rabbit' for a dog, 'bedroom' for a kitchen). Target the correct entity, or 'scene' for a wrong setting. Not for a wrong name, role, or profession on the right entity; that is I2.
suggestion_intent: A prominent character or object in the scene, or the setting itself, has not been mentioned by the child. Target the most story-relevant unmentioned entity, or 'scene' if the place has not been named. Not for entities already mentioned but unnamed; that is I2.
